title: IT Audit 1
subtitle: Practice test
source: Auditing review, OS, networks, databases, and integrated practice questions

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Who is primarily responsible for adopting sound accounting policies, maintaining adequate internal controls, and making fair financial statement representations?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Management.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Management certification of quarterly and annual financial statements by CEOs and CFOs is required for:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: U.S. public companies only.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: What is the primary objective of an external financial statement audit?

choices.text: To guarantee that no fraud has occurred within the company
To design and implement the company's IT infrastructure
To obtain reasonable assurance about whether financial statements are free from material misstatement and express an opinion
To train internal auditors on regulatory compliance

questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: To obtain reasonable assurance about whether financial statements are free from material misstatement and express an opinion.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: External auditors of U.S. public companies must provide an opinion on whether internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR) are effective for:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: U.S. public companies only.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Under PCAOB AS 2110, external auditors must obtain an understanding of the company’s information system related to financial reporting, specifically:

choices.text: How the company uses IT and how IT affects the financial statements
The cost of all IT hardware purchased in the last 10 years
The exact programming code of every application
Personal social media profiles of IT executives

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: How the company uses IT and how IT affects the financial statements.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which organization issues Information Systems Auditing Standards (ISASs)?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: ISACA.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Professional certification holders expected to comply with Information Systems Auditing Standards (ISASs) are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: CISAs.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Internal auditors can only assist external auditors in an audit engagement if they report directly to:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: The Audit Committee.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: In the United States, an internal audit department is required for companies trading on the:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: According to the Institute of Internal Auditors, internal auditors are expected to evaluate:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: IT governance and effectiveness.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which framework identifies 3 main objectives and 5 components of internal control?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: COSO Internal Control Framework.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: The three main objectives of internal control on the COSO cube columns are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Operations, Reporting, Compliance.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: How many fundamental principles map to the 5 components in the COSO framework?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: 17.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: An example of a non-IT authorization control activity is:

choices.text: Requiring a physical signature before extending a customer’s credit limit

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Requiring a physical signature before extending a customer’s credit limit.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Separating transaction processing from transaction authorization is an example of:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Separation of duties.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: A supervisor signing off on a subordinate’s cash reconciliation work is a form of:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Supervision and review.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Controls designed to reduce the frequency of undesirable events occurring are classified by intention as:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Preventive.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Controls designed to identify and expose undesirable events that elude preventive controls are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Detective.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Controls designed to fix identified problems are categorized as:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Corrective.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Controls part of the underlying IT infrastructure upon which accounting systems depend are called:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: IT General Controls (ITGCs).

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: ITGCs are considered "entity-level" controls because they:

choices.text: Apply strictly to paper document storage

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Pertain to entity-wide IT infrastructure.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Transaction processing controls that are embedded directly within the Accounting Information System (AIS) are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Application Controls.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Pervasive controls that mitigate the risk of unauthorized access across systems are known as:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Access Controls.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: In the Audit Risk Model ($DR = AR / (IR \times CR)$), if Control Risk ($CR$) decreases because controls are tested and effective, Detection Risk ($DR$) can:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Increase (allowing for audit efficiency).

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Exceptions discovered during tests of controls:

choices.text: Do not necessarily indicate a monetary misstatement
Automatically trigger a restatement of income

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Do not necessarily indicate a monetary misstatement.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Substantive testing aimed at income statement transactions is known as:

choices.text: Substantive tests of details of account balances

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Substantive tests of transactions.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Substantive testing aimed at balance sheet accounts is known as:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Substantive tests of account balances.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which assertion addresses whether recorded transactions actually occurred during the accounting period?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Occurrence.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which assertion addresses whether all transactions that should have been recorded are actually recorded?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Completeness.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which assertion ensures transactions are recorded in the proper accounting period?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Cutoff.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which assertion ensures recorded balance sheet assets exist at the balance sheet date?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Existence.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which balance assertion addresses whether assets are the rights of the entity and liabilities are obligations of the entity?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Rights and Obligations.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: In the client-server model, a server is best described as a:

choices.text: Powerful host computer providing services to multiple client computers
Physical wire connecting keyboard to monitor

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Powerful host computer providing services to multiple client computers.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: What step in the external audit cycle involves IT auditors working separately from the financial audit team?

choices.text: Understanding the complexity of the entity’s IT

questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Understanding the complexity of the entity’s IT.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Providing management with IT-related recommendations at the end of an external audit cycle is performed by:

choices.text: IT auditors separately from the financial audit team

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: IT auditors separately from the financial audit team.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: A substantive analytical procedure typically requires comparing a client's recorded balance against:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: An independently developed expectation.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Which COSO control component includes management’s tone at the top, ethical values, and organizational structure?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Control Environment.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Reperforming client control procedures is a procedure used during:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Tests of controls.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Physical controls over assets and records fall under which COSO component?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Control Activities.

questions.module: Auditing Review & Intro to IT Audit
questions.prompt: Are PCAOB AS 2110 requirements regarding understanding IT controls relevant if the auditor plans a non-reliance (substantive) strategy?

choices.text: Yes, auditors must still understand IT to assess risk of material misstatement
Only if the client uses cloud computing
Only if requested by the internal audit team

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Yes, auditors must still understand IT to assess risk of material misstatement.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT one of the three main tasks performed by an operating system?

choices.text: Translating program language into machine-executable language
Authorizing physical entry into the building server room

questions.explanation: The correct answer is D: Authorizing physical entry into the building server room.

questions.prompt: Why is OS security critical to the Accounting Information System (AIS)?

choices.text: If OS integrity is compromised, application-level controls can be bypassed
The OS contains physical paper records
The OS replaces the need for a database management system
The OS prevents power grid failure

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: If OS integrity is compromised, application-level controls can be bypassed.

questions.prompt: Which group of employees typically poses the highest threat to OS security due to elevated privileges?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Power users / system administrators.

questions.prompt: Password policies requiring at least 14 characters apply primarily to:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Reusable passwords.

questions.prompt: For multi-factor authentication (MFA), the recommended minimum password length according to CIS guidelines is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: 8 characters.

questions.prompt: Passwords that are defined once and reused over a specific timeframe (e.g., 6 weeks) are called:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Reusable passwords.

questions.prompt: An RSA token that generates a dynamic code paired with a PIN is an example of:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) / One-time password.

questions.prompt: What is considered the "gold standard" for text-based authentication credentials?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Passphrases.

questions.prompt: Combining fingerprint recognition and facial recognition in a single access mechanism is known as:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Multimodal biometric authentication.

questions.prompt: Best practice for storing OS password files involves:

choices.text: Plain text files in root directory
Printing hard copies for the librarian

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Encrypting or hashing.

questions.prompt: A cryptographic process that transforms input data into a fixed-length output string and is irreversible is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Hashing.

questions.prompt: Audit trails that log every individual action and character entered by a user are performing:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Keystroke monitoring.

questions.prompt: Audit trails that summarize key activities and system resources accessed are performing:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Event monitoring.

questions.prompt: How do auditors verify that OS access privileges are appropriate?

choices.text: By allowing all employees admin rights during testing
By sampling users and checking access against job functions
By shutting down the server during operating hours

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: By sampling users and checking access against job functions.

questions.prompt: Preventing users from installing unauthorized software on company computers mitigates the threat of:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Malicious/destructive programs.

questions.prompt: What is a key drawback of biometric authentication devices?

choices.text: They cannot be integrated with systems
Privacy concerns, false acceptance/rejection rates, and cost
They require users to memorize 20-digit codes
They are strictly prohibited by auditing standards

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Privacy concerns, false acceptance/rejection rates, and cost.

questions.prompt: How do auditors test whether OS audit trail controls are effective?

choices.text: Observing whether trails are enabled and scanning logs for unusual activity

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Observing whether trails are enabled and scanning logs for unusual activity.

questions.prompt: An accidental threat to an operating system includes:

choices.text: OS crash due to hardware malfunction

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: OS crash due to hardware malfunction.

questions.prompt: Password policies should explicitly prohibit credentials using:

choices.text: Personal information (e.g., pet names, birth dates)

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Personal information (e.g., pet names, birth dates).

questions.prompt: Routine anti-virus software updates are designed to prevent:

choices.text: Denial of Service attacks on routers

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Malicious program execution.

questions.prompt: A network covering a small geographic area such as a single office building is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: LAN (Local Area Network).

questions.prompt: A network covering large geographic locations across multiple sites or cities is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: WAN (Wide Area Network).

questions.prompt: A restricted, closed network accessible only to a specific internal group is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Intranet.

questions.prompt: Individual computers or peripheral devices (like printers) connected to a network are called:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Nodes.

questions.prompt: Which network hardware component configures connections to optimize and preserve network bandwidth?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Switch.

questions.prompt: Which network component selects the most efficient path for transmitting data messages?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Router.

questions.prompt: Data transmissions over networks are chopped into smaller pieces called:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Packets.

questions.prompt: A firewall technique that permits or blocks incoming and outgoing packets based on IP addresses is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Packet filtering.

questions.prompt: A system designed to evaluate packet contents against a database of known signatures to block malicious traffic is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Intrusion Prevention System (IPS).

questions.prompt: In public key (asymmetric) encryption, data encrypted with a public key can only be decrypted using:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: The receiver's private key.

questions.prompt: Digital certificates are issued by a trusted third party known as a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Certification Authority (CA).

questions.prompt: To ensure that network messages have not been deleted, duplicated, or reordered, companies implement:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Message Sequence Numbering.

questions.prompt: A technique where the receiver returns a copy of the received message to the sender for comparison is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Echo Check.

questions.prompt: Parity checks add a bit to data packets to test whether the sum of 1s in the transmission is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Odd or even.

questions.prompt: What emerging technology poses a significant threat to current public key encryption schemes due to immense decryption capabilities?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Quantum computing.

questions.prompt: Embedding hidden identification details into standard multimedia files to protect copyright is called:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Watermarking.

questions.prompt: An attack designed to flood a network server with traffic so legitimate users cannot access services is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Denial of Service (DoS) attack.

questions.prompt: Periodic control messages sent across a network to verify that connections are active and unintercepted are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Request-Response Techniques.

questions.prompt: Network risk caused by internal employees improperly altering sensitive data on the corporate network is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Intranet risk.

questions.prompt: How do auditors test network equipment failure controls?

choices.text: Inquiring/observing echo or parity checks and reviewing transaction logs for transmission errors

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Inquiring/observing echo or parity checks and reviewing transaction logs for transmission errors.

questions.prompt: An organization’s database is defined as a:

choices.text: Collection of physical paper filing cabinets
Structured set of digitally stored data

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Structured set of digitally stored data.

questions.prompt: What is a primary disadvantage of the traditional flat-file database approach?

choices.text: Extreme speed of multi-user data sharing

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Data redundancy, inefficiency, and inconsistency.

questions.prompt: Under the Database Management System (DBMS) approach, data is stored:

choices.text: Multiple times across every user's C-drive
Once, reducing redundancy and update conflicts

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Once, reducing redundancy and update conflicts.

questions.prompt: The specialized programming language used by a DBMS to define user permissions and database structures is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Data Definition Language (DDL).

questions.prompt: The level of database view that describes how data is physically stored on media is the:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Physical internal view.

questions.prompt: The level of database view defining the specific subsets of data visible to individual end-users is the:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Subschema / User View.

questions.prompt: Relational databases link data files across tables using:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Common key fields.

questions.prompt: The standard language used for querying relational databases is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: SQL (Structured Query Language).

questions.prompt: To prevent unauthorized access, a DBMS checks user requests against a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Data authorization table.

questions.prompt: A control that prevents users from deducing unauthorized sensitive statistics by restricting queries returning very few records is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Inference Control.

questions.prompt: Under inference controls, a query result returning fewer than 2 records will generally be:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Blocked/Suppressed by the system.

questions.prompt: Masking sensitive data (such as showing an SSN as xxx-xx-1234) protects data:

choices.text: In transit over local switches only
By obfuscating sensitive content in end-user views
By converting files into magnetic core loops
By eliminating the need for passwords

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: By obfuscating sensitive content in end-user views.

questions.prompt: Who should hold exclusive responsibility for designing user views and updating the data authorization table?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Database Administrator (DBA).

questions.prompt: How do auditors verify that DBAs maintain proper separation of duties?

choices.text: Reviewing access logs to confirm only DBAs program user views and checking job descriptions

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Reviewing access logs to confirm only DBAs program user views and checking job descriptions.

questions.prompt: Database backup controls require creating a full copy of the database at least:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Once a day (or more frequently).

questions.prompt: Modern physical data storage in solid-state drives (SSDs) relies on:

choices.text: Stacks of rotating metal discs with magnetic spots

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Silicon integrated circuits.

questions.prompt: Older physical storage consisting of metal discs with magnetic spots written on them describes:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Hard Disks.

questions.prompt: Storing backup copies of physical data files must occur:

choices.text: In the server room directly on top of the host rack

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: At an off-site location.

questions.prompt: If a database is corrupted or compromised, what is the immediate impact on the AIS?

choices.text: The AIS continues running without impact
The AIS fails because it depends directly on the database
The AIS converts to paper mode automatically

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: The AIS fails because it depends directly on the database.

questions.prompt: Audit testing of inference controls involves:

choices.text: Inspecting water pipes in the basement
Performing interviews and attempting to "back into" sensitive data via creative queries

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Performing interviews and attempting to "back into" sensitive data via creative queries.

questions.prompt: Who should initiate system change requests?

choices.text: End-users responsible for specifying business needs

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: End-users responsible for specifying business needs.

questions.prompt: Requests for low-risk IT changes generally require authorization review by:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Low-level IT personnel.

questions.prompt: System changes should be rigorously tested in which environment prior to live deployment?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Development environment.

questions.prompt: The live software environment used to run daily business operations is the:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Production environment.

questions.prompt: Programmers should NOT have regular, unrestricted access to:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Production environment source code.

questions.prompt: Who controls access to production environments and grants temporary passwords after receiving testing proof?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Program Librarian.

questions.prompt: An development methodology characterized by quick, iterative, incremental software modifications is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Agile change.

questions.prompt: How do auditors test change management controls?

choices.text: Selecting a sample of changes to verify user initiation, authorization, and testing

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Selecting a sample of changes to verify user initiation, authorization, and testing.

questions.prompt: To reduce flood and foot-traffic risks, a computer center should ideally be located:

choices.text: On a top floor or raised floor of its own building
Next to a main water line

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: On a top floor or raised floor of its own building.

questions.prompt: Computer center building construction controls mandate that windows should:

choices.text: Be made of standard single-pane glass

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Not open.

questions.prompt: High humidity levels in a data center environment primarily increase the risk of:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Mold growth.

questions.prompt: Low humidity levels in a computer center increase the risk of:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Static electricity.

questions.prompt: An uninterruptible power supply (UPS) such as a generator acts as a control against:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Power outages and utility failures.

questions.prompt: A system's capacity to continue operating smoothly even when a component fails is called:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Fault tolerance.

questions.prompt: Redundant Array of Independent Disks (RAID) uses multiple hard drives to enable error recovery via:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Hot-swapping.

questions.prompt: The general industry benchmark timeframe target for business recovery following a disaster is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: 72 hours (3 days).

questions.prompt: A formal set of enterprise-wide procedures designed to restore normal operations after a disaster is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP).

questions.prompt: Plans focused specifically on maintaining continuous business operations during an ongoing disaster are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Business Continuity / Contingency Plans.

questions.prompt: Plans focused on rapidly detecting and containing security incidents (like a data breach) to minimize damage are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Incident Response (IR) Plans.

questions.prompt: The point in the future by which an organization target to be back up and running (maximum acceptable downtime) is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Recovery Time Objective (RTO).

questions.prompt: The maximum acceptable data loss measured in time prior to an outage is the:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Recovery Point Objective (RPO).

questions.prompt: Disaster recovery teams focus primarily on:

choices.text: Strictly enforcing separation of duties rules during the crisis
Rapid execution of critical recovery duties without strict separation of duties

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Rapid execution of critical recovery duties without strict separation of duties.

questions.prompt: A disaster recovery site arrangement where two companies agree to handle each other’s processing needs is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Mutual Aid Pact.

questions.prompt: An empty building leased for disaster recovery without installed computer hardware is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Cold Site / Empty Shell.

questions.prompt: A fully equipped data center operated by a third party and shared among multiple subscribers is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Recovery Operations Center (ROC).

questions.prompt: A fully equipped, company-owned backup computer center dedicated solely to that firm is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Internally Provided Backup / Hot Site.

questions.prompt: A virtual, cloud-based container storing encrypted recovery data that automatically activates upon primary database loss is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Vault.

questions.prompt: A DRP test where individuals read the recovery document independently and offer written feedback is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Paper test.

questions.prompt: A DRP test where key teams meet around a table to discuss operational responses step-by-step is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Walkthrough test.

questions.prompt: A DRP test where primary systems are completely shut off while business operations run on backup systems is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Cutover test.

questions.prompt: A DRP test where backup systems process live transaction data simultaneously while primary systems remain active is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Parallel test.

questions.prompt: How do auditors evaluate the adequacy of a client's DRP?

choices.text: Inspecting critical application lists, interviewing recovery teams, and checking site documentation
Inspecting sales invoices for math errors

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Inspecting critical application lists, interviewing recovery teams, and checking site documentation.

questions.prompt: Mission-critical applications prioritized in a DRP typically include:

choices.text: Cash-generating functions, AR collections, and vendor payments

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Cash-generating functions, AR collections, and vendor payments.

questions.prompt: Which site recovery option carries the risk that the helper organization may face its own crisis and refuse access?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Mutual Aid Pact.

questions.prompt: Physical computer center access controls typically include:

choices.text: Locked doors accessible via keypads/keycards and video surveillance

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Locked doors accessible via keypads/keycards and video surveillance.

questions.prompt: What type of fire suppression system is appropriate for host computer rooms?

choices.text: Clean agent / non-water gas suppression systems

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Clean agent / non-water gas suppression systems.

questions.prompt: Fire alarms in a secure computer center should be connected directly to:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: The local fire station.

questions.prompt: Examining change logs for unusual off-hours entry by unauthorized developers tests:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Change management controls.

questions.prompt: Which DRP site option represents the most expensive choice for an organization?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: Internally provided hot site.

questions.prompt: Verifying system fault tolerance during an audit involves testing whether:

choices.text: The server shuts down whenever any error occurs
Operations continue seamlessly when an individual system component fails

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Operations continue seamlessly when an individual system component fails.

questions.prompt: The protection of network systems, operating software, and digital data from compromise is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Cybersecurity.

questions.prompt: Cyber attacks targeting employees via deceptive emails to fraudulently disburse cash are:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is B: Email schemes / Business Email Compromise.

questions.prompt: Malicious software designed to record every key pressed by an end-user is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Keystroke logger.

questions.prompt: Malware that encrypts company data assets and demands payment in exchange for decryption keys is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Ransomware.

questions.prompt: An attack where a perpetrator impersonates a legitimate officer to manipulate staff into revealing credentials is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Social engineering.

questions.prompt: A rogue Wi-Fi access point configured to mimic a legitimate network to intercept user traffic is an:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Evil Twin.

questions.prompt: Sending a volume of data exceeding system buffer capacity to crash or gain access to a system is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Buffer overflow / overrun.

questions.prompt: An attack bypassing firewalls by embedding stolen data in unused header spaces or transmission timing of packets uses:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Covert channels.

questions.prompt: Exploiting system timing to force a system designed for sequential processing to perform concurrent tasks is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Race condition / TOCTTOU.

questions.prompt: Manipulating trusted web application code to execute malicious scripts inside a victim’s web browser is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

questions.prompt: Injecting malicious commands into a database entry field to alter backend database queries is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: SQL injection (SQLi).

questions.prompt: Using automated brute-force attempts to systematically uncover valid server database usernames and passwords is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Enumeration.

questions.prompt: Eavesdropping on network traffic, intercepting packets, and modifying message contents to deceive recipients is a:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Man-in-the-Middle / Interception attack.

questions.prompt: Malicious software designed to travel across connected systems without user interaction, modifying files without consent, is:
questions.explanation: The correct answer is A: Malicious Mobile Code (MMC).

questions.prompt: Software deployment policies allowing employees to connect personal smartphones to enterprise databases are:
